Home.heroTitle: Your Home, No Matter Where You're From.
Home.heroLead: Nestled between tropical gardens and the tranquil shores of Vung Bau Beach, Mai Phuong is a rustic retreat where life slows down and simple moments of calm return.
Home.introTitle: A quiet stay on Pearl Island
Home.introBody: Mai Phuong Resort welcomes guests on Phu Quoc with private space, sea light, and meals on the grounds. From this page you can browse rooms, restaurants, spa, island tours, and park tickets. Direct bookings will enter the hotel system once the API docs are ready.

Home.sliderAria: Five senses at Mai Phuong Resort Phu Quoc
Home.slideTagline: No matter where you come from, Mai Phuong welcomes you like family.
Home.slideSightTitle: Where the blue sea embraces the garden
Home.slideSightBody: Some journeys begin with a single glance. Between the blue waters of Vung Bau and rustic bungalows tucked among tropical gardens, Mai Phương invites you to imagine a peaceful escape, away from the rush of everyday life.
Home.slideSightImageAlt: Aerial view of the sea and gardens at Mai Phuong Resort
Home.slideListenBody: The gentle sound of waves blends with the breeze rustling through the coconut palms, bringing a sense of relaxation from the very first moment. Surrounded by the soothing sounds of nature, everyday worries begin to fade away, and your holiday truly begins.
Home.slideListenImageAlt: Pool and sea at dusk at Mai Phuong Resort
Home.slideTouchBody: Unwind with every gentle massage movement, letting everyday tiredness fade as you enjoy a quiet moment just for yourself.
Home.slideTouchOffer: Special Offer: Stay 3 nights or more and enjoy one complimentary 30-minute massage session.
Home.slideTouchImageAlt: Relaxing spa space at Mai Phuong Resort
Home.slideTasteBody: After hours by the sea, awaken your taste buds with the aroma of freshly grilled seafood, the tangy flavours of hot pot, and a refreshing fruit juice — simple tastes that create lasting memories at Mai Phương.
Home.slideTasteImageAlt: Outdoor dining at sunset at Mai Phuong Resort
Home.slideScentBody: Along shaded garden paths, the scent of tropical greenery mingles with the refreshing sea breeze. Every breath invites you to slow down and appreciate the simple beauty all around.
Home.slideScentImageAlt: Green walkway in the grounds of Mai Phuong Resort

About.metaTitle: Our Story · Since 2002 | Mai Phuong Resort Phu Quoc
About.metaDescription: The Mai Phuong Resort story from 2002 to today: a familiar place by Vung Bau Beach, Phu Quoc.
About.s01Intro: A peaceful corner of Phu Quoc, where Mai Phuong's story began in 2002.
About.s01Body: Nestled beside Vung Bau Beach, among coconut palms and lush gardens, Mai Phuong has welcomed many seasons by the sea. Much has changed over the years, yet its simple charm and familiar warmth remain, just as they did in the beginning.
About.s01MapAlt: Illustrated map of Phu Quoc with Mai Phuong Resort at Vung Bau Beach
About.s01MapCaption: Illustrated map · Mai Phuong Resort, Vung Bau Beach, Phu Quoc
About.s02Body1: Nestled beneath coconut palms and along shaded garden paths, Mai Phuong was simple and rustic in those early days: timber roofs, stone walls, swaying hammocks, and meals overlooking the sea.
About.s02Body2: Never about grandeur, Mai Phuong grew from a simple wish: to create a welcoming place where travellers from far away could find peace and the familiar feeling of home.
About.s02Note: Mai Phuong archives · The early days by the sea.
About.s02Photo1Alt: Timber bungalow among trees at Mai Phuong in earlier days
About.s02Photo2Alt: Stone-walled bungalow from Mai Phuong's early years
About.s03Title: A glimpse of Mai Phuong, back then.
About.s03Lead: These old photographs capture Mai Phuong as it once was — bungalows nestled among green gardens, thatched shelters by the sea, simple meals, and memorable moments through the years.
About.s03Footer: * Archive photographs supplied by Mai Phuong; individual photo dates have not been assigned.
About.archive1Body: Photographs of the moments shared together at Mai Phuong.
About.archive2Body: Rustic details in stone, timber and coconut palms.
About.archive3Body: A hammock, a shady corner, and an unhurried afternoon.
About.archive4Body: Nothing extravagant, just the simple comforts of a good night's rest.
About.archive5Body: Sea air and stories shared around the table.
About.archive6Body: Sea, sand and palms — the things that stayed.
About.archive7Body: Dappled shade and steps taken slowly.
About.archive8Body: A spontaneous moment captured during a seaside holiday.
About.archive9Body: Some journeys are remembered through the people who shared them.
About.s04Lead: Every chapter brings change. And every guest who visits adds a little story to Mai Phuong's journey.
About.s04Y2002Body: Mai Phuong begins with rustic bungalows by Vung Bau Beach.
About.s04MidBody: Our spaces and gardens are cared for and renewed, while a welcoming spirit stays close to our hearts.
About.s04Y2026Body: A new chapter with a beachfront pool, dining, spa and more ways to unwind.
About.s05Lead: Not the same camera angle, but the same place. From the gardens and bungalows of yesterday to the Mai Phuong you see today.
About.s05ThenAlt: Gardens and bungalows at Mai Phuong in earlier days
About.s05NowBody: A new chapter, beside the familiar sea.
About.s05NowAlt: Current bungalows and walkways at Mai Phuong
About.s06Title:
A new Mai Phuong.
The same familiar
warmth.
About.s06Body: More than two decades later, Mai Phuong offers new spaces to enjoy — a seaside pool, garden bungalows, dining and spa experiences. But the things we treasure most remain: simplicity, genuine care, and the feeling of being welcomed like family.
About.valuesTitle:
The simple things
stay with us.
About.valuesLead: However times may change, we believe the most memorable stays are often made of the simplest things.
About.value1Body: Sea, sunshine, greenery and quiet moments.
About.value2Body: A familiar place, without the fuss.
About.value3Body: Welcoming every guest with genuine care.
About.closeTitle:
Your Home, No
Matter
Where You're From.
About.closeBody: Wherever you're from, you're always welcomed like family at Mai Phuong.
About.closeAlt: Mai Phuong gardens and bungalows among the trees
